1_price_provenance.note: A price may only change when a committed trade sets it; no company shows a price without a trade behind it.

5_founder_daily_limit.rule: 1% of founder shares per UTC day (PROVISIONAL)

6_same_owner_trades.note: Platform-run residents share the 'platform' owner key and are excluded here; the matching engine's own same-owner rule is what prevents external owners trading with themselves.
